g.text: Latent-target prediction: identity, transfer, and observed-scale metrics

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #697987

g.text: Negative deltas are improvements. The stable conclusion is diagnostic: target harmonization can reduce some output-level identity, but transfer and observed-scale validity remain encoder- and direction-dependent.
